article.body_preview:
DHAKA, April 12, 2023 (BSS) - The poverty rate in the country came down at 18.7 percent at the national level, which is 20.5 percent in the rural areas and 14.7 percent in the urban areas, according to the key findings of the Household Income and Expenditure Survey 2022.

The survey findings also showed that the overall rate of extreme poverty in the country is 5.6 percent, which is 6.5 percent in the rural areas and 3.8 percent in the urban areas.
